instrument: tools/request-accounting.py + tools/regression-request-accounting.sh + docs/infra/request-accounting.md — report-only, no epistemic claim rows
headline: Nothing in the repo counted provider requests; it does now, per model and per rolling window, joined from the two harnesses' own stamped fields (claude: num_turns in the teed envelope; pi: assistant-role messages in the session transcript) — and the ollama '100% of the window consumed' note is corrected to a brief, 1.3%-refusal ceiling, not a window-long exhaustion.

facts_confirmed_or_corrected.fact_1_nothing_counts_requests: CONFIRMED — grep -rln "request_count|requests_used|n_requests|request budget" tools/ bin/ still returns nothing (re-run 2026-08-24 09:2xZ).
facts_confirmed_or_corrected.fact_2_one_dispatch_is_hundreds_of_reque: CONFIRMED, and it is the design's crux: a claude dispatch's teed envelope carries num_turns independent of success/error (verified on untracked/tokens/T836...claude.stdout.log, an is_error attempt with num_turns=53); a pi/ollama session transcript carries one assistant-role message per completed model reply. Neither was read anywhere in the repo before this row.
facts_confirmed_or_corrected.fact_3_session_transcripts_are_attributa: CONFIRMED for lanes dispatched with --session (run_record.session_path, T662) — verified the real predicate against untracked/tokens/sessions/T849....jsonl: type=="message" && message.role=="assistant" is the request; role=="toolResult" and role=="user" are not requests to the provider.
facts_confirmed_or_corrected.fact_4_ollama_server_log_insufficient_al: CONFIRMED — [GIN] lines carry status/duration but no model field (it lives in the request body), and the log also counts non-chat endpoints (/api/status, /api/tags, /api/me). Used only as a cross-check on the ollama family's known total, never as an attribution source; the two numbers are reported side by side, never reconciled (docs/infra/request-accounting.md).
facts_confirmed_or_corrected.fact_5_ollama_100pct_consumed_corrected: CORRECTED — docs/status/RESUME-orcha.md states '100% of the 5-hour window consumed' for 2026-08-24. Measured 2026-08-24 09:19Z: that UTC date shows 936 [GIN] lines through 09:19Z, 923 status-200, 12 status-429 (1.3% refusal) — a brief ceiling, not a window-long exhaustion. 2026-08-20 is the actually-saturated comparator: 4,734 lines, 331 refusals, 1,848 in the single 13:00 hour. Both corrected figures and methodology are recorded in docs/infra/request-accounting.md; RESUME-orcha.md itself is not edited (not a declared deliverable of this row).
facts_confirmed_or_corrected.fact_6_some_lanes_unattributable: CONFIRMED — a pi/openrouter/local lane with no --session at dispatch (session_path is null on the run record; the ox-alpha shape) is reported UNKNOWN with the run record's own reason, never folded into 0 or the total. The default cwd-slug session directory (~/.pi/agent/sessions/<cwd-slug>/) that could sometimes recover these is deliberately NOT scanned here — that is tools/token-backfill.py's (T746) existing, more careful retroactive-recovery machinery (tolerance + corroboration against run records); duplicating a narrower version of it here would repeat this project's own 'two implementations of one idea' defect class.

measured_last_full_window.note: window length is imported from tools/window_policy.WINDOW_SECONDS (5h), not a second literal (T850 constraint) — see docs/infra/request-accounting.md "The window"
measured_last_full_window.starvation_flag_this_window: none — max family share observed is minimax-m3 at 36.9% of ollama, well under the 80% threshold; the live fleet in this window is NOT in the starved shape the brief describes, which is itself useful: the instrument now exists before the next incident, not after it.

ollama_cross_check.note: the 97-request gap is expected — [GIN] counts non-chat endpoints (status/tags/me polling) the session-transcript join never sees; never reconciled into one number, per design.

what_remains_unmeasurable: pi/ollama/openrouter/local lanes dispatched without --session (no session_path on the run record) — UNKNOWN, by design (see fact_6 above); recoverable in principle only by tools/token-backfill.py's separate retroactive scan, not reproduced here.

claude attempts whose stdout tee is missing, unreadable, or whose envelope lacks num_turns (an older CLI, or a lane killed before any stdout capture) — UNKNOWN, with the specific reason recorded per attempt.
any lane dispatched through a harness that is neither `claude -p` nor `pi ...` in its command string — UNKNOWN; no join is attempted rather than guessed.

sub-dispatch turns inside a single provider call (e.g. a claude tool-use round that itself fans out to a cheaper model, visible in the T836 envelope's own modelUsage.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 entry inside an opus dispatch) are folded into the DISPATCHED model's num_turns, not separately attributed — the envelope reports it, but this row's join does not split it out; noted as a real but out-of-scope refinement, not silently dropped.
notes: MEASURES ONLY, per the brief's explicit boundary — no dispatch gate, no cap, no change to bin/dispatch/tools/fleet_caps.py/tools/window_policy.py/tools/runner. Inbox checked empty at claim and before this close (bin/managent inbox T850 --ack, no directives). Regression run twice: RED with tools/request-accounting.py moved aside (all 8 arms fail/error), GREEN restored (all 8 pass) — both runs observed directly in this session, not asserted from memory.
